worksheet.node_id: Node 1: High Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: High process gas outlet temperature from cooler E-004
causes: Cooling water control valve TCV-201 stuck closed
Loss of cooling water supply or pressure
consequences: High temperature feed entering High Temperature Shift Converter R-003, potentially causing catalyst sintering, thermal runaway, or mechanical overstressing of the reactor.
Simultaneous freeze-up of the cooling water side of E-004 due to the same valve failure

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature control loop TC-201 / TT-201 controlling TCV-201 on cooling water outlet
Independent high-temperature shutdown already installed and interlocked to isolate feed

safeguard_gaps: No independent high temperature alarm or automatic shutdown to protect R-003 from high inlet temperature
recommendations: Install a high-temperature alarm (TAH) on TT-201 and implement a high-temperature reactor feed trip loop to isolate or bypass feed if temperature limits are exceeded.

worksheet.node_id: Node 1: High Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in High Temp. Shift Converter R-003
causes: Downstream line blockage or closure of downstream valves
Excessive upstream feed rate from R-002
consequences: Vessel overpressure, risk of physical rupture of R-003 and release of toxic and flammable syngas.

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure safety valve (PSV) on the top outlet of R-003

worksheet.node_id: Node 1: High Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: Excessive catalyst bed temperature in R-003
causes: Runaway exothermic water-gas shift reaction
Significantly elevated inlet gas temperature from E-004 failure
consequences: Catalyst sintering and permanent activity loss
Vessel shell overheating beyond design temperature (427°C)
safeguard_gaps: No vessel temperature safety instrumented system (SIS) or interlock
recommendations: Install multi-point thermocouple indicators inside R-003 connected to a high-temperature alarm (TAH) and an automated quench gas or emergency shutdown system.

worksheet.node_id: Node 2: Low Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: High outlet temperature on the tube side of E-005
causes: Bypass control valve TCV-202 fails in open position, bypassing too much hot process fluid around the cooling shell side
consequences: High temperature feed downstream towards E-006, leading to increased load on E-006 and risk of elevated feed temperature into LT Shift Converter R-004.

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature control loop TT-203 / TC-204 controlling bypass valve TCV-202

safeguard_gaps: No high-temperature alert or mechanical stroke limit on bypass valve TCV-202
recommendations: Install a mechanical travel stop on TCV-202 to prevent total bypass flow, and configure high-temperature alarms in the DCS.

worksheet.node_id: Node 2: Low Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: High process gas temperature leaving E-006
causes: TCV-203 cooling water valve fails closed
Failure of cooling water utility loop
consequences: Feed entering Low Temperature Shift Converter R-004 exceeds design temp (220°C), causing rapid, irreversible catalyst degradation of the copper catalyst.

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature control loop TT-205 / TC-206 controlling cooling water valve TCV-203

safeguard_gaps: No independent safety trip to isolate R-004 feed on high-temperature
recommendations: Implement a high-temperature trip interlock on TT-205 that initiates a safety shutdown (e.g., closing feed isolation valves) if temperature climbs towards 220°C.

worksheet.node_id: Node 2: Low Temperature Shift Converter System
worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in LT Shift Converter R-004
causes: Downstream blockage in E-007 or V-001 inlet
consequences: Overpressure and potential rupture of the vessel shell (design pressure 2332.9 kPa).

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure safety valve (PSV) on the top inlet line of R-004

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level in Knockout Drum V-001
causes: LCV-201 drain control valve fails closed
Sudden excessive condensation of water/process fluids
consequences: Liquid carryover into the overhead process gas line, leading to flooding, damage, or contamination of downstream CO2 Absorber column C-001.

existing_safeguards.description: Level control loop LT-211 / LC-212 / LCV-201 draining to waste water treatment plant
High-high level safety trip already installed and interlocked to isolate upstream feed

safeguard_gaps: No independent high-high level alarm or safety trip to prevent overhead liquid carryover
recommendations: Install an independent high-high level alarm (LAHH) and high-level safety interlock to shut off upstream process feed or trip the unit before carryover occurs.

worksheet.deviation_description: Low liquid level leading to vapor blowby in V-001
causes: LCV-201 fails in fully open position
consequences: Vapor blowby of high-pressure syngas into the low-pressure Waste Water Treatment Plant system, causing severe overpressure, rupture hazard, or toxic gas release in WWTP.

existing_safeguards.description: Level control loop LT-211 / LC-212 / LCV-201

safeguard_gaps: No low-level interlock to isolate drain line on loss of liquid seal
recommendations: Install a low-low level alarm (LALL) and automatic shutdown interlock to close LCV-201 or a separate ESD valve on low level.

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level at the bottom sump of CO2 Absorber C-001
causes: Bottom level control valve LCV-202 fails closed
Downstream solvent transfer pump failure
consequences: Sump flooding, filling up active tray/packing sections of C-001, resulting in severe solvent carryover to the clean gas overhead line leading to R-005, and amine/absorbent loss.

existing_safeguards.description: Level control loop LT-213 / LC-214 controlling LCV-202

safeguard_gaps: No independent high-high level shutdown interlock on the column sump
recommendations: Install an independent High-High Level Alarm and Interlock (LAHH) to trip/shut off incoming solvent and feed gas flows.

worksheet.stream_ref: Lean Solvent Feed Line (top of C-101)
worksheet.deviation_description: Low or completely lost solvent flow to top of C-001
causes: Solvent control valve FCV-201 fails closed
Upstream solvent circulation pump failure
consequences: Inadequate or zero absorption of CO2 from the process gas, leading to high CO2 concentration ('slip') in the overhead product gas flowing to Methanator R-005. High CO2 slip will cause catastrophic temperature runaway in R-005.

existing_safeguards.description: Flow control loop FT-220 / FIC-221 / FCV-201 on solvent feed

safeguard_gaps: No emergency automatic trip system linked directly to downstream Methanator safety on low solvent flow
recommendations: Install a low flow alarm (FAL) on FIC-221 and initiate a hardwired interlock to isolate gas feed or trip the downstream Methanator reactor if solvent flow drops below a critical safety threshold.

worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in CO2 Regenerator column C-002
causes: CO2 off-gas control valve FCV-204 fails closed
Blockage or restriction in the CO2 product vent line
consequences: Overpressure of the column C-002, threatening physical damage to column packing, trays, or vessel shell (design pressure 2053.7 kPa).
Sudden loss of column pressure causing flashing and cavitation of the reboiler circulation pump

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure control loop PT-225 / PIC-224 controlling FCV-204 on overhead line
Pressure safety valve (PSV) on C-002 overhead line

worksheet.deviation_description: Excessive temperature in the reboiler / bottom of C-002
causes: Heat medium control valve FCV-203 fails open, feeding excessive steam/heat to the reboiler
consequences: Thermal degradation of the amine solvent, increasing corrosion rates in the system and loss of absorption efficiency.

existing_safeguards.description: Flow control loop FT-219 / FIC-220 / FCV-203 on heat medium supply
High-temperature cut-off already installed on the reboiler heat medium supply

safeguard_gaps: No high-temperature cut-off on the reboiler heat supply
recommendations: Install a temperature transmitter on C-002 bottom sump with an interlock to shut/trip FCV-203 if temperature exceeds solvent thermal degradation threshold.

worksheet.deviation_description: Severe thermal runaway inside Methanator R-005
causes: High concentration of CO or CO2 slip in the feed gas (due to C-001 absorption system failure / low solvent flow)
consequences: Extreme heat generation due to highly exothermic methanation reaction, resulting in vessel design limit (330°C) violation, catalyst sintering, and catastrophic reactor shell rupture.

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure safety valve (PSV) on the inlet of R-005

safeguard_gaps: No automatic safety instrumented system (SIS) to isolate feed gas on high temperature runaway
recommendations: Install a high-temperature safety trip system (interlock) with voting logic (e.g. 2oo3 thermocouples) to automatically close a fast-acting isolation valve on the feed gas stream if bed temperature exceeds 330°C.
Install a continuous online CO/CO2 analyzer on the feed gas to R-005 to alarm and initiate an early trip.

worksheet.deviation_description: Reduced purge gas recycle flow from K-006 back to the synthesis loop
causes: Compressor K-006 mechanical trip or seal failure
Recycle line partial blockage
consequences: Buildup of inert gases (methane, argon) in the ammonia synthesis loop, reducing overall conversion efficiency and increasing energy consumption
safeguard_gaps: No flow monitoring or low-flow alarm on the purge gas recycle line
recommendations: Install a flow transmitter and low-flow alarm on the K-006 recycle discharge line
